description: Generate a comprehensive, in-depth client report as a polished A4 PDF in the Vizuara Ramco house style. Orchestrates two skills: vizuara-ramco-pdf for the layout and print pipeline, and wisprflow-figure for every chart or stat figure. Writes in a natural human voice with no em dashes. Use when the user asks for a full report, proposal, engagement roadmap, status review, evaluation writeup, or any long client-facing PDF that needs figures.
